summary: Critical outage in postgres-primary caused by disk_full (INC-0043)
description: Service postgres-primary incident INC-0043. Symptoms: database write rejections. Error: java.io.IOException: Disk space is full for path /var/lib/postgresql/data. Root cause was disk_full. Followed runbook RB-disk-full.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for postgres-primary and applied RB-disk-full.
